properties.why: The centre of Franklin Square: in the USGS NAIP photograph of 7 July 2023 and the MassGIS 15 cm leaf-off photograph of spring 2023 a round paved plaza about 24 m across (inside the ring path that is already mapped) holds a stone-rimmed round fountain basin about 14.5 m across, with the fountain itself at its centre. Added as a fountain of that diameter; the pipeline's standard basin and central pedestal stand in for its design (the pipeline draws every basin with water, although this one looks dry or planted in both photographs).

The plaza is a pale paved surface (not lawn) out to the ring path; its material is not clear from either photograph, so it is drawn as ordinary pavement.
